method: Compared lesson text, local synthetic fixtures, checkpoint metadata, and registered official OWASP/AWS references. Executed all three complete Python fences and checked host-bound tenant/scope authorization and safe error/log output. No provider calls were made. Rendered the production page at 1300px CSS width in light and dark themes; both full-page captures have 1300px width, document scrollWidth is 1300px, one Mermaid diagram renders, and no page alert appears.
limitations: The 2026-10-09 three-path demonstration constructs local test strings only; it did not inspect production traces, logs, network requests, or provider retention.
The new broker and upstream are fake local objects. They do not validate a real secrets manager, workload identity, tenant authorization service, sandbox isolation, or deployed logging pipeline.
Official documentation was opened on 2026-10-21; no live credential was used and no production/provider behavior was tested.

The browser run emitted a favicon 404; the page itself had no alert, rendered the Mermaid diagram, and had no horizontal overflow. Browser console also retained prior-session errors from other localhost ports, so no claim is made about clearing the shared console history.
